hypothesis: Aggregate independently associated contour/wheel observations before fitting and prediction to reduce frame noise; train and infer at the same passage level.
visibility: Minimum of the two observed wheel height/width ratios, clipped to [0.05,1]; squared for weighting. No missing wheel imputation.
model: Existing nine contour and visible-wheel features; family-balanced ridge with existing alpha grid.
selection: Nested whole-family exclusion for coefficients and alpha, comparing family midpoint MAE and worst catalogue endpoint error. All 78 original comparison rows retained through current heldout fallback.
association: Recompute prior dense bidirectional association decisions; do not transfer lengths to rejected views.
additional_cohort: Freeze seven newly researched identities/ranges. Do not fit their references. Check all-fitted model on those existing anchor features, explicitly single-view stress test only.
adoption: Do not install a method merely because mean error improves. Inspect worst error, all cases and evidence support. Catalogue agreement is not verified physical accuracy.
